title: Bones on religion: humans and aliens part of the same creation

tellings.quote: he mentioned that the that we are part of the same creation.

plain: A contact Dan Sherman calls Bones once told him that humans and aliens are part of the same creation. Sherman is a former Army sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that intercepts communications, hired him to speak with aliens. He says this happened while he was posted at a site he calls Base 2, sometime between 1990 and 1993. If it is true, it would put people and visitors under one shared origin, which bears on religion.
